name: @quarry/forge-agent
description: ForgeAgent: one per compute machine. Takes Forge jobs from the queue, runs each in its runtime's container (docs/design/forge-runtimes.md) and reports them to the server's ForgeAgent API (/api/forge-agent/…). No database access.

scripts.dev: nodemon -w src -w ../shared -e ts,json --exec ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register src/main.ts
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.build.json
